# Hitesh Rana

> Hitesh Rana is a backend engineer at Mercari working on fraud and risk systems. His portfolio covers distributed systems, database internals, Go developer tools, open-source projects, AI-assisted experiments, and engineering contributions.

This is a single-page personal portfolio. Project metrics, work history, and outcomes are self-reported professional information, not independent benchmarks. The website is the source for the accompanying Markdown snapshot.

## Portfolio

- [Full portfolio in Markdown](./llms-full.txt): Biography, five backend projects with technology stacks and production impact, open-source contributions, Mercari roles, and three AI-assisted experiments with technology stacks.
- [Website](https://hitesh22rana.github.io/): Original portfolio with about, projects, work, and experiments sections.
- [Resume](./resume.pdf): Downloadable professional resume.
